AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE CODE OF THE CITY OF SANTA CLAUS, GEORGIA, AND PARTICULARLY AMENDING ARTICLE VII, ADDING SECTION 74 TO BE TITLED SHORT-TERM RENTALS AND TO REPEAL CONFLICTING ORDINANCES; AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES.

To be codified in Article VII as Section 74 - SHORT- TERM RENTALS
1:
The purpose of this ordinance is to preserve the residential character of neighborhoods, protect the health, safety, and welfare of residents, and prevent the negative impacts associated with transient occupancy.

(74.1) Definitions

¢ Short-Term Rental (STR): The rental of a dwelling unit, or any portion thereof, for a period of less than 30 consecutive days.

° Dwelling Unit: A building or portion thereof designed for residential occupancy by one or more persons.

(74.2) Prohibition

- (a) It shall be unlawful for any person to operate, advertise, or offer a short-term rental within the city limits.

- (b) No property owner, tenant, or agent shall permit the use of any dwelling unit as a short-term rental.

(74.3) Enforcement (a) The mayor and\or the City Council shall investigate complaints and monitor compliance. (b) Violations shall be subject to: 1. A fine of up to $500 per day for each day the violation continues. (74.4) Exceptions This ordinance shali not apply to: e STR such as Airbnb establishments that reside within commercially zoned areas.

e Rentals of 30 days or more.

(74.5) Effective Date

This ordinance shall take effect 30 days after adoption.
